dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgTakeOffer.title: Msg Take Offer
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgTakeOffer.description: * TakeOffer executes one or more orderbook takes with netting and settlement. Behavior: - Processes multiple take operations in a single transaction with aggregated settlement. - For each take: validates offer exists and is open, parses take_units (defaults to remaining), computes exchange amounts (required_want = take_units × unit_want, deliver_have = take_units × unit_have), aggregates outputs by address, updates offer state (closes when fully taken), records operations. - Post-processing: computes maker wants and taker credits, nets taker credits against maker wants, covers deficits from taker base balance (uses module backing for remaining solid deficits). - Settlement: executes batch coin movements via wsMoveCoins for all participants. - PFAND release: when offers close, locked PFAND flows from module to taker. - Trade recording: creates single Trade with all operations, indexed by trader/offer. Validation: - Taker address must be valid. - Trades list must be non-empty. - Each offer must exist and be in open status. - Take_units must be valid integer string (positive, ≤ remaining); empty defaults to remaining. - For LIQUID settlement: maker must have sufficient balance for deliver_have. - Module must have sufficient backing for any uncovered solid deficits. Emits: - EventOfferTaken for each take (offer_id, trade_id, units_taken) - EventTradeRecorded for the batch (trade_id, trader, num_operations) - EventPfandReleased for each closed offer (amount, offer_id, trade_id) Returns: - aggregated sent/received totals across all executed takes.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer to take from; offer must exist and be in open status.

take_units.description: Units to take (sdk.Int string). If empty, take full remaining. Must be positive and ≤ remaining.

sent.description: Total coins the taker sent across executed trades (usually want denom).

received.description: Total coins the taker received across executed trades (usually have denom).
